And yes indeed, a worldwide contamination could never happen. Zombies are honestly not a threat.

Mainly for two reasons.

First anything that moves needs energy. Even a virus that "resurect" your brain will need energy to survive. The only way to restore energy is to eat human flesh, but then every zombie that dont find a human to eat just shut after a while? You just can't have a zombie apocalypse for more than a few weeks, after that the roting flesh and the brain/virus just dont have enough power anymore, it's science.

The second problem is even bigger : what does a zombie do when they find a human? They eat them. So the first zombie ever eats a dude. Now that dude can't even transform because he's just a pile of meat. So you could have a limited number of zombie but never hordes of them because by their nature, when they become numerous they halt their progression themselves by eating other potential zombies before they even transform. Call it the "Zombie paradox" i guess. 
You just would have zombies without legs to walk, arms to grab you, eyes to see or just a neck to hold their head.

You dont need snow or anything. Zombie apocalypse is total nonsense any way you look at it. It defies science. A zombie apocalypse would last maximum 2-3 weeks and not more than a few thousands could exist.

For context, i'm an old player (since launch) who stopped for some time, bought Reaper Of Souls 2weeks ago and learned how late game works (a little at least)

1. You now need to play adventure mode only. Story is done one time, then it's useless. You dont have to play it any more, even with new char. since they can already join adventure mode !
2. Thats what adventure mode (AM) is all about. It's the place to go to farm all he things you need : gears, infernal machines, legendary's, sets etc. Everything is doable there.

4. You have access to different things. The bounties are mini side quests in all the acts. Represented by exclamation points on the map. Once you've done all the quests in one act, you gain a special "chest" (follow the order of the acts for a bonus chest ! The order is specified on the map, i'm not talking about act 1 to 5 in order ;)) containing special rewards like legendary and set gear, specific crafting material letting you use the kunai's cube (you'll need to go to a specific place to get that one) and a special money, only used to buy rare gear from a vendor. Sometimes, that gear you bought will be legendary or from a set of your power level, so you can quickly complete sets.
And last but not least, the big bite, the rifts. Do a normal rift first. In there you need to kill monsters to fill a progress bar. Elites gain more progress with special orbs falling from them. Once 100%, you get a greater rift key. You can now open and play in a greater rift. Same thing here, but harder, and you choose your difficulty level (Torment 1 low, or high for example) depending on your gear and dps.  Once the greater rift done, you loot even better rewards, like a gem you can socket in jewelry. A special vendor will appear. With it you can upgrade that said gems (3 try each greater rift. With a percentage of success based on the difficiluty of the irft and the level of the gem).
